headline: Last session: Sensex gains 308 points, Nifty reclaims 23,000 led by IT and pharma stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: In the last trading session, IT and pharma stocks rallied, supporting the main benchmark indices.
Bulls regained control as Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level and Sensex closed 308 points higher.
Midcaps and smallcaps underperformed in Friday's session despite the rise in front-line stocks.
Over the weekly wrap, Sensex and Nifty gained 2% while Nifty Smallcap 100 jumped 4%.
whatHappening: On the last trading day (30 Oct), Sensex ended 308 points higher while Nifty closed above 23,050.
IndiGo shares jumped 4% and HCLTech gained 2% during Friday's trading session.
Value-fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail received SEBI approval to raise funds through a public IPO.
Earlier on Thursday, Sensex soared 905 points led by rallies in FMCG and financial stocks.
summary:
On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices ended higher with Sensex gaining 308 points and Nifty reclaiming the 23,000 mark.
Key stock gainers included IndiGo and HCLTech on Friday, following strong buying in Adani Enterprises and Kotak Bank on Thursday.
The stock market is closed today, 31 October 2026, due to the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday, 2 November.
